en.title: Come, Thou Long-Expected Jesus
en.author: Charles Wesley
stanzas:
[E]Come, thou long ex[B7]pected [E]Jesus,
[E]born to [A]set thy [B7]people [E]free;
[C#m]from our [A]fears and [E]sins re[B7]lease us,
[E]let us [A]find our [B7]rest in [E]thee.

Israel's strength and consolation,
hope of all the earth thou art;
dear desire of every nation,
joy of every longing heart.

Born thy people to deliver,
born a child and yet a King,
born to reign in us forever,
now thy gracious kingdom bring.

By thine own eternal spirit
rule in all our hearts alone;
by thine all sufficient merit,
raise us to thy glorious throne.

notes: Text: hymnary.org representative text (United Methodist Hymnal, 1989), unchanged wording; UMH prints it as two 8-line stanzas, split here into four 4-line stanzas to match the 8.7.8.7 tune. STUTTGART is the tune hymnary's text authority lists; HYFRYDOL (8.7.8.7 D) is the other common pairing. Hymnary's tune page gives STUTTGART in F Major; F moved to E per the guitar rule (E is the nearest allowed key). Chart is a best-effort functional harmonization of STUTTGART, not note-checked against a score.
